servicesSub: Commercial, strata and home cleaning across Townsville, weekly, fortnightly or one-off.

services.title: Body corporate cleaning
services.short: Common areas, stairwells, foyers, lifts and toilets in unit complexes.
services.long: Regular cleaning of the shared spaces in unit complexes: common areas, stairwells, foyers, lifts and toilets, kept to the same standard every visit.

services.title: Office & commercial cleaning
services.short: Commercial, industrial and retail offices, weekly or fortnightly.
services.long: Weekly or fortnightly cleaning for commercial, industrial and retail offices, plus office vacate cleans when you move out.

services.title: After-trade cleaning
services.short: Insurance repairs, renovations and small builders' cleans.
services.long: When the trades are done, we clean up after insurance repairs, renovations and small builds so the space is ready to use.

services.title: Window & shopfront cleaning
services.short: Commercial and retail shopfront windows, plus windows and screens.
services.long: Shopfront windows for commercial and retail premises, and window and screen cleaning for homes and offices.

services.title: House washing & pressure cleaning
services.short: External house washing, paths, fencing, driveways and acid cleaning of concrete.
services.long: External house washing and pressure cleaning of paths, fencing, driveways and shopfronts, plus acid cleaning of concrete patios and garages.

services.title: Carpet & upholstery
services.short: Carpets, mattresses, mats, lounges and window furnishings.
services.long: Carpet and soft furnishing cleaning, including mattresses, mats, lounges and window furnishings.
